audits.claim: Two failed SMS scheduling runs cause a future reminder to be deleted on the next cron run, even if the failure was temporary.
audits.evidence: packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/reminders/smsReminderManager.ts:228-238 creates unscheduled reminders more than seven days ahead, with retryCount defaulting to zero (packages/prisma/schema.prisma:1000); scheduleSMSReminders.ts:48-59 selects them once they enter the seven-day window. For a reminder due six days from now with valid message/recipient and configured Twilio credentials, a locked owner makes twilioProvider.ts:90-95 return undefined, so scheduleSMSReminders.ts:178-186 increments retryCount on each of two runs. The cron is configured every 15 minutes (.github/workflows/cron-scheduleSMSReminders.yml:8), and the third run, about 30 minutes after the first failure, deletes the row solely because retryCount > 1, without checking its future scheduledDate or logging deleted IDs (scheduleSMSReminders.ts:28-45). Unlocking the user later only changes smsLockState (packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/admin/setSMSLockState.handler.ts:18-30), so the deleted row cannot be selected and retried; the previous date-only deletion in inputs/cal.com-14943.diff retained it until its scheduled time. Thrown provider failures also increment the same counter (scheduleSMSReminders.ts:158-166,189-198), so a transient scheduling outage has the same loss path.
